#### IMPORT DATA FROM DBMS (SQLite)

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

# Create a database file on your computer
con <- dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "agricultural_trials.db"
)

# Create sample data
trial_data <- data.frame(
  farmer_id = c(101, 102, 103, 104),
  treatment = c("Control", "Rocket", "BTK", "Chamak"),
  yield_t_ha = c(2.1, 2.8, 3.4, 3.2)
)

# Save the data as a database table
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  "trial_results",
  trial_data,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dbListTables(con)

data <- dbReadTable(
  con,
  "trial_results"
)

print(data)

# Query selected data using SQL
data_filtered <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT *
   FROM trial_results
   WHERE yield_t_ha > 3"
)

print(data_filtered)

# Disconnect when finished
dbDisconnect(con)
```

#### IMPORT DATA FROM MYSQL / MARIADB

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RMariaDB)

# Note: Set eval=FALSE so R Markdown doesn't fail when knitting without an active database connection
con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname = "your_database",
  host = "your_server",
  port = 3306,
  user = "your_username",
  password = "your_password"
)

data_mysql <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM your_table LIMIT 100"
)

dbDisconnect(con)
```

#### IMPORT DATA FROM API (COMMCARE)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# Project domain and credentials
domain <- "your-project-domain"
url <- paste0("[https://www.commcarehq.org/a/](https://www.commcarehq.org/a/)", domain, "/api/form/v1/")

username <- "your_username"
api_key <- "your_api_key"

# Send request
response <- request(url) |>
  req_auth_basic(username, api_key) |>
  req_url_query(limit = 20, offset = 0) |>
  req_perform()

resp_status(response)

# Read the response
result <- resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(result$objects)
str(result$objects[[1]])
```
